original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚将埃博拉患者空运至瑞士
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卫生与社会福利部长阿里·帕特确认，该国首例输入性埃博拉病毒病患者因临床状况好转，已获准从阿布贾撤离至瑞士。患者为一名瑞士外交官的妻子，其配偶无症状并一同撤离。部长强调，患者病情改善且实验室结果趋近基线，并不意味着她已不再具有传染性。

location.site: 纳姆迪·阿齐基韦国际机场私人飞机航站楼
location.raw_text: Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚卫生部长确认该国首例输入性埃博拉患者被撤离至瑞士
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NIGERIA’S Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Ali Pate, has confirmed the evacuation of the country’s first imported Ebola virus disease patient to Switzerland

key_facts.fact: 患者为一名瑞士外交官的妻子，其配偶无症状并一同撤离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The patient, a wife of a Swiss diplomat in Nigeria, was evacuated alongside her spouse, who has remained asymptomatic

key_facts.fact: 部长表示患者病情改善不代表已不再具有传染性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This does not mean she is not still infectious, hence the strict protocols in place

key_facts.fact: 撤离行动于周一早6时在阿布贾机场私人飞机航站楼进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: heightened activity at the private jet wing of the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja at 6 a.m. on Monday

uncertainties: 事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
患者当前传染性状态及后续公共卫生风险有待核实
